description: Takes each order that arrives on the order queue (an email, a ticket, or a file such as a PDF or photo), saves the original, and creates the order in the Orders table so Order Desk can start work on it. PDFs, spreadsheets, Word and RTF files and saved emails are read directly; scans and photos are copied out to text by AI. This is the only step that touches the queue.
